title: One Hundred
materials: Household rhythm sticks or wooden spoons
quest_mission: Join Kwame & Octavia in Numeria on an acoustic sensory quest to explore One Hundred.
rhythm_ignition: Teacher models a steady 2-minute rhythmic call-and-response beat to 'One Hundred', synchronizing clapping and vocal chanting with the children.
tactile_ritual:
The Hands-On Sensory Discovery:
1. Children gather in a circle with tactile items.
2. Follow the musical cues of One Hundred to touch, sort, and move in rhythmic unison.
3. Pair high-reach movements with deep somatic exhalations.
4. Freeze in quiet stillness at the final chord.

socratic_wonder_circle.rhythm_cue: 100 BPM Decuple Clap-Check (10-20-30... Spot the Structure!)
socratic_wonder_circle.wait_time_rule: Hold a calm 4-beat pause after every question before inviting responses.
prompts: Noting Structural Similarities & Differences (S-29): How is counting by tens (10, 20, 30... 100) like counting 1 to 10—and what makes ten-bundles faster and more reliable?
Developing Evaluation Criteria (S-15): If we have a giant jar of 100 beans, what criteria make a counting method fair and easy to double-check without losing track?
Refining Generalizations (S-10): Does a bigger pile ALWAYS have more items than a neat stack of 100 small stones? How could big blocks trick our eyes?

age_tier_scaffolds.Sprouts (Ages 2–4): Drop 10 stones into a cup together and cheer each full bundle of ten.
age_tier_scaffolds.Pathfinders (Ages 4–5): Compare a loose messy pile of 20 beans with two neat 10-stone rows to check accuracy.
age_tier_scaffolds.Wayfarers (Ages 6–7): Design a rule for verifying a 100-item count and explain why visual volume can mislead.

domain_spider.language: Articulate clear auditory phrasing and target vocabulary connected to One Hundred.
domain_spider.cognitive: Identify rhythmic patterns, tempo shifts, and conceptual categories in Numeria.
domain_spider.physical: Gross motor whole-body balance, bilateral coordination, and fine motor finger rhythm.
domain_spider.science_sensory: Tactile exploration of real-world materials and acoustic auditory pitch discrimination.
domain_spider.social_emotional: Cooperative participation, shared attentional focus, and calming self-regulation.

teacher_whisper: Auditory rhythmic pacing stimulates brainstem regulation and synchronizes attention across the classroom without visual screen fatigue.

standards.kindergarten_readiness: Actively participates in screen-free multi-sensory rhythm rituals and articulates key conceptual observations.
